guides.title: Starting seeds indoors in Toronto
guides.summary: Timing, light, and hardening off for a short spring window.

sections.title: When to start
sections.body: Tomatoes and peppers: 6–8 weeks before last frost (late May in Toronto). Hardy greens: 4 weeks. Check your balcony or plot microclimate — lake effect can delay frost.

sections.title: Light and airflow
sections.body: Use a full-spectrum grow light 12–14 hours daily. Run a small fan on low for sturdy stems. Thin seedlings so leaves are not touching.

guides.title: Community plot etiquette
guides.summary: Shared beds, shared tools — how to be a good plot neighbor.

sections.title: Paths and borders
sections.body: Keep aisles clear. Mark your bed corners if the site allows. Compost weeds in designated bins only.

sections.title: Water windows
sections.body: Many sites restrict hose hours. Water deeply less often rather than a daily sprinkle.

tasks: Sow cover crops on empty beds
